## Welcome to Statistics Campus

**Statistics, Data Analysis & Research Methods**

Statistics Campus provides scientific explanations, practical examples, and step-by-step tutorials for students, researchers, and professionals interested in statistical methods and data analysis.

Our articles combine statistical theory with practical applications, primarily using R. Depending on the topic, they include mathematical formulas, statistical analyses, R code, visualizations, and guidance on interpreting results.
